rationale.consistency: Matches Go idioms well, correctly using standard slices and maps packages.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options map, invalid option recovery, and concurrent usages effectively.
rationale.scope: Strictly limits changes to fixing the global order state leakage without unrelated refactoring.
rationale.readability: Clean refactoring of the positional switch and clear, expressive slice operations.
rationale.robustness: Cloning the options map and the order slice perfectly prevents data races and cross-adaptation state leaks.
rationale.maintainability: Properly scopes the custom order to the adaptation options context, removing fragile package-global mutations.
